title: After the Rain
style: Sultry darkwave indie electronic, 108 BPM, moody minor-key synths, crisp drum machine, deep bass, reverb-soaked guitar textures, intimate breathy female vocal, seductive and melancholic, late-night city mood
negativeTags: country, happy, EDM drop, metal, chiptune, upbeat pop
lyrics:
[Verse]
Wet pavement shines like broken stars
I trace your name on foggy cars
You never said the words out loud
You only spoke inside the crowd

[Chorus]
After the rain, you come undone
Shadows dancing, two as one
After the rain, the city sighs
Secrets hiding in your eyes

[Bridge]
Say it slow, say it low
Only the night will ever know
